description: Dossiers d'Information Mairie (DIM) - Antennes de téléphonie mobile - Ville d'Orléans is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Dossiers d'Information Mairie (DIM) concernant les antennes de téléphonie mobile. Ce jeu de données alimente la datavisuation. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The publisher named on the listing is Orléans Métropole. Its keywords include amenagement-numerique. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
